summary: Phases 0 (ChronicleInterface skeleton) and 1 (generic Types.lean, both trees re-exporting) of the 9-phase Chronicle consolidation are committed, green, and sorry/axiom-free. Phase 2 (RRelation shared core, ~38 lemmas) was surveyed but not attempted this run: reading both trees' RRelation.lean files (Temporal 746 lines, Bimodal 1694 lines) showed the shared core needs ~15 additional axiom-level ChronicleInterface fields (implication-property analogue, ~14 named Axiom.* lemmas used via DerivationTree.axiom, contraposition/doubleNegation/dni, tempKDistDerived/pastKDist, two absurdity lemmas) plus the two fields deferred from Phase 0/1 (untlLeftMonoDeriv, combineImpConj, now safely importable at this layer). Each needs careful per-logic name/signature verification before becoming an interface field; rushing this risked either an incomplete abstraction or leaving mid-phase uncommitted work, so the run stopped at the Phase 1 checkpoint (fully green, fully committed).
decisions_made: ChronicleInterface F is a structure (not a class): bimodal supplies an instance family fun fc => ..., temporal a single .Base instance; only MCS/Burgess apparatus lemmas are statement fields, definitional notions stay generic defs over an interface value. Landed and green (Phase 0).

ChronicleInterface.lean reuses SinceSeedConsistency.lean's generic definitional-notion defs (isSetConsistent, isSetMaximalConsistent, rBurgessOf, etc.) directly via ci-prefixed thin wrappers, rather than duplicating them -- avoids namespace collision since both live in Cslib.Logic.Metalogic.Chronicle.

untlLeftMonoDeriv and combineImpConj were removed from ChronicleInterface after landing (Phase 0) once Phase 1 work revealed their only proofs live downstream of ChronicleTypes.lean (each tree's PointInsertion/Burgess.lean) -- importing them at this layer would create an import cycle. Deferred to Phase 2, which sits at the correct layer.

DEVIATION from the original plan: the Chronicle structure itself and its conditions (c0-c5', ValidChronicle, ChronicleInvariant, C3 consequences) stay logic-local (unchanged) rather than being routed through the generic Types.lean Chronicle/conditions machinery. A toGeneric-bridge draft compiled standalone but broke rcases/simp proofs in downstream CounterexampleElimination/*.lean files (both trees) that pattern-match on Finset-membership subterms nested inside condition statements. This is a permanent deviation, not a to-be-revisited TODO -- do not re-attempt the bridge in a later phase.

Both trees re-export generic declarations under existing names via abbrev/theorem aliases so downstream files are minimally perturbed (confirmed working for the DCS/r-relation/r-maximality/Burgess-relation layer across all downstream CEE/ChronicleConstruction files in both trees).

Phase order follows research risk gradient: interface skeleton -> ChronicleTypes -> RRelation core -> CEE pipeline (3-way split 3a/3b/3c) -> ChronicleConstruction (2 halves 4a/4b) -> cleanup. Fully sequential; each phase is one green lake build + commit.

Logic-local declarations kept out of scope: bimodal's 2 duality theorems and 2 GProp/HProp eliminators and ~24 RRelation extras; temporal's deductiveClosure_singleton_imp' variant. If any shared proof resists generic abstraction, keep it logic-local rather than introducing a sorry.
SinceSeedConsistency.lean left untouched (Phase 0/1 did not modify it); the optional Phase 5 reconciliation remains open, skipped if it risks re-verifying the green Since path.
dead_ends: Task premise 'watch the bimodal RRelation sorry' is STALE: RRelation.lean is sorry-free; its only 'sorry' is a stale doc-comment (~line 40) fixed in Phase 5. The only real proof sorries live in ChronicleToCountermodel.lean (17, pre-existing, unchanged, confirmed by grep after Phase 1).

ChronicleToCountermodel.lean is genuinely divergent (no temporal counterpart, blocked on external GoodStructuresModelSurgery port) and is OUT OF SCOPE: never consolidated, imported into, or entangled with any generic module. Confirmed no import edge introduced.
Direct code-sharing impossible: bimodal and temporal have distinct Formula and DerivationTree types; interface parameterization over abstract F + abstract derivation family is mandatory.

A toGeneric bridge for the Chronicle structure (routing Chronicle.c0-c5' through the generic module via chi.toGeneric := <chi.f, chi.g, chi.dom>) compiles standalone but breaks rcases/simp in downstream CounterexampleElimination/*.lean proofs that pattern-match on Finset-membership subterms nested inside condition statements -- do not re-attempt this approach.

Full-project `lake build` currently fails on Cslib/Logics/Modal/Tableau/LoopChecking.lean, an unrelated file mid-edit by a concurrent session (task 511); confirmed via git log that its last commit belongs to a different task. Not caused by this task -- use scoped `lake build <module>` for verification until that resolves.
